# Zoho Flow On-Prem Extension SDK

Current supported language: Java
SDK version: 1.0.0
Java target: 11

Canonical entry points:
- README.md
- sdk/java/README.md
- sdk/java/docs/getting-started.md
- sdk/java/docs/java-api.md
- sdk/java/docs/transformation.md
- sdk/java/docs/packaging.md
- samples/README.md

Generation constraints:
- Use "On-Prem Extension" consistently in customer-facing prose.
- Do not present Python or Node.js SDKs as available.
- Declare the SDK via Maven (com.zoho.flow:zohoflow-onprem-extension-sdk) with scope=provided; json.jar is a transitive dependency and needs no separate declaration.
- Do not include zohoflow-onprem-extension-sdk.jar or json.jar in connector upload ZIPs.
- Use only customer-facing APIs documented by the Java API reference.
- Do not call Agent lifecycle initialization methods.
- Prefer static fields when the schema is known at implementation time.
- Treat the ready-made sample ZIP as an intact upload artifact. After deployment, its discovered actions run through the selected On-Prem Agent inside a Flow.
- Discover implemented samples through samples/README.md.
